title: Play as The Whale
description: A third character unlocked with CLOUT in the Market: slow and huge, its own animated sprite, starter weapon and a trait that vacuums every XP candle on screen once a minute.

title: Crypto Winter Night: a fourth map
description: An unlockable map where the screen goes dark between candle flashes, with a new Frost Miner enemy, a boss variant, its own music mood and a map pick for free runs.

title: Missions: goals that pay CLOUT
description: Goals per character and per map (Survive 10:00 as Pepe, kill Rug Lord without a hit) that pay CLOUT once, with progress on the title screen and a toast when one lands.
